description: Official NBG rate of one currency (GEL per one unit) in force on every calendar day of an inclusive range of at most 366 days. Dates are calendar days in Tbilisi. Days without a rate of their own (Sundays, Mondays and days after a public holiday; before September 2021 NBG set a rate for every calendar day) carry the earlier rate. Days whose own rate is in force contain only date and rate; a carried-over day adds effectiveDate and carriedOver: true. Quote effectiveDate when carriedOver is true. A range reaching a date NBG has not published yet returns an error. summary holds the first, last, change, lowest and highest rate with their dates, and the average over the calendar days, computed by the server: report those rather than deriving them. One NBG request per call.

to.description: Last calendar day, inclusive. At most 366 days including "from".

name: nbg_rate_history

carriedOver.description: Present, and true, only on days that carry a rate set earlier

effectiveDate.description: Present only on carried-over days: the calendar date the rate took effect. When absent, the rate took effect on date.

rate.description: GEL per ONE unit of the currency

summary.description: Computed by the server; report these instead of deriving them from days. change and average are exact, rounded half up to the decimals NBG's quantity gives the currency, 4 + log10(nbgQuantity), the largest over the days (4 for USD, 7 for AMD).

average.description: Arithmetic mean over every calendar day of the range, carried-over days included

change.description: last minus first, exact, at the decimals NBG's quantity gives the currency

maxDate.description: First calendar day the maximum occurs on

minDate.description: First calendar day the minimum occurs on

title: NBG rate history
